title: PLAY THIS EVERY MORNING BEFORE YOU START YOUR DAY [7:45AM Prayers For You] APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
text: Stop. Don't move yet. Before you pick up your phone, before you check your notifications, before you let the noise of the world come crashing into the sacred silence of this new morning, stop. Just stop. Because this moment right here, this thin fragile golden moment between sleep and the world, this is holy ground and most people waste it. >> [music] >> They stumble out of bed and immediately hand the first moments of their consciousness to newsfeeds and WhatsApp messages and yesterday's unresolved anxieties. And then they wonder why their days feel like they're running behind something they can never catch. But not today. Not you. Not anymore. Today you are going to do something different. Today you are going to begin where every victorious day must begin in the presence of God, in the word of God, in the spirit of God. And I want you to make this a covenant not just today, but every morning, every single morning. As long as you have breath in your body, you are going to open your day in this atmosphere before you open it to anything else. Lift your hands right where you are. In your room, in your car, wherever you are listening to this, lift your hands and say, "Lord, this day belongs to you before a single event unfolds. Before a single meeting, before a single phone call, I give you this day and I receive from you everything I need to live it victoriously." Now, let me give you your anchor scripture. Turn in your spirit to Psalm 5 verses 3 and the Lamentations 3 verses 22 through 23. Psalm 5 verse 3 says, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." And Lamentations 3 verses 22 and 23, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. Two things I need you to see before we go any further. In Psalm 5:3, David says, "In the morning, I will direct my prayer and look up." Not just pray direct. The word direct in Hebrew carries the idea of laying something in order, like a soldier arranging his armor before battle, like a priest arranging the sacrifice before the fire comes. There is an intentionality to morning prayer that most people have never understood. You are not just venting to God in the morning. You are positioning yourself. You are arranging your spirit. You are setting the trajectory of the day in the spiritual realm before it unfolds in the natural realm. The morning prayer is not reactive. It is proactive. You are not praying because something bad already happened. [music] You are praying before it can happen. You are setting the terms of engagement for the day before the day sets them for you. And then David says, "I will look up." After I direct my prayer, I will look up. He's not looking at his circumstances. He's not looking at his schedule. He's not looking at his problems. He's looking UP at God, at the throne, at the one who sits above every situation, above every limitation, above every enemy, above every impossibility. And in Lamentations, oh, this is so rich, he says, "His compassions are new every morning. Not recycled. Not left over from yesterday. New." Which means whatever mercy you needed yesterday, there is a fresh batch this morning. Whatever grace was depleted in the battles of the week, it has been replenished overnight. Whatever you came through that nearly broke you, you are standing in front of a fresh dispensation of the compassion of God. Great is his faithfulness. His faithfulness is great, meaning it is big enough for your problems, it is wide enough for your situation, it is deep enough for your needs. And it is consistent enough that you can build your life on it without fear of it shifting beneath you. Now, before I go into prayer because we are going to pray with holy violence this morning, I need to preach to you for a few minutes about why the morning matters more than most believers understand. Genesis chapter 1, "In the beginning God said, 'Let there be light.' And there was light. And God divided the light from the darkness. He called the light day, and the darkness he called night." And then comes one of the most important statements in all of scripture for understanding how God moves. It says, "And the evening and the morning were the first day." Evening and the morning. In Hebrew time and in the understanding of sacred time, the day begins not at sunrise, but at evening. The Jewish day begins at sundown. Which means that before the morning even arrives, the foundation of the day has already been laid in the previous night. But here is what I want you to see spiritually. God established a rhythm, evening, rest, surrender, trust, morning, arising, readiness, light. The pattern is surrender then rise. Darkness then light. Rest then activity. And when you pray in the morning, when you deliberately choose to meet God before you meet, the day you are aligning yourself with the divine rhythm of creation, you are saying, "I was made for this. I was made to arise into light after a period of surrender. I was made to imagine to my day from the presence of God and not from the noise of the world." Proverbs 8:17, wisdom says, "I love them that love me, and those that seek me early shall find me." Early, before the demands come, before the emails arrive, before the children wake up, before the market opens, before the traffic starts, seek me early and I will be found. And you know what is interesting? Jesus practiced this. The Son of God, the one in whom all the fullness of the Godhead dwelt bodily, Colossians 2:9, he had a morning prayer practice. Mark chapter 1:35, "And in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." If the Son of God found it necessary to spend the very first moments of his day in prayer, how much more do we need it? Jesus did not begin his ministry day from his last conversation the night before. He did not begin his day from the momentum of yesterday's miracle. Every morning was a fresh download, a fresh connection to the Father, a fresh loading of anointing, authority, and direction. And that is what this morning prayer is designed to do for you, to load you with what you need for what you are about to walk into. Because here is the thing, they never tell you some of what would try to destroy you today was assigned last night. Some of what would challenge you in the next few hours was already set in motion in the spiritual realm while you were sleeping. And if you walk into the day without engaging the spirit, without covering yourself with the blood, without releasing angels, without setting your spirit for victory, you are walking into a spiritual battlefield in casual clothing. Ephesians 6:13-18, "Wherefore take unto you the whole armor of God that you may be able to withstand in the evil day and having done all to stand." The armor, the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, the shoes of the gospel of peace, the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation, the sword of the spirit. This is morning equipment. >> [music] >> You put this on before you go into battle, not in the middle of it. And prayer is how you put it on. Prayer is how you fasten the armor. Prayer is how you secure the shield. Prayer is how you grip the sword. Every morning prayer is a divine arming ceremony for the battles of the day. So, understand this. When the enemy tries to make you rush past your morning prayer, when the alarm goes off and suddenly everything feels urgent and there is no time to pray, he's not trying to steal 30 minutes from your schedule. He's trying to send you to war naked. He knows that a prayed up child of God is one of the most dangerous forces on the planet. And he knows that an un-prayed child of God, no matter how talented, no matter how gifted, no matter how anointed they were last Sunday, is vulnerable. You will not give him that advantage. Isaiah 40:30 and 31, "Even the youth shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall, but they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. They shall run and not be weary, and they shall walk and not faint." They that wait upon the Lord, the morning wait, the morning watch, the deliberate pausing before God before charging into the day. That waiting produces a supernatural replenishment of strength that no amount of sleep, no amount of coffee, no amount of motivational content can produce. Eagle wings. The eagle does not flap furiously to maintain altitude. The eagle finds a thermal current, the rising air, and spreads its wings and soars. And the morning wait on God positions you in the thermal current of the Holy Spirit. So instead of spending your whole day frantically flapping, striving, grinding, forcing, manipulating, anxiety managing, you soar. You move in the flow of what God is already doing. And what takes other people 10 hours to accomplish, a person who is in the flow of the spirit can accomplish in two. Let me give you one more thing before we go into prayer and then we're going to pray with everything we have. Psalm 19:24 Moses prays and says, "Oh satisfy us early with thy mercy that we may rejoice and be glad all our days." Satisfy us early, not in the evening, not in the afternoon when things have already gone sideways, early in the morning. Because the satisfaction that comes in the morning, the sense of being full of God, full of his mercy, full of his presence before the day begins, that satisfaction is what carries joy through the entire day. You cannot manufacture joy in the middle of a hard day if you did not receive it in the morning. You cannot sustain peace through a stressful afternoon if you did not secure it before the day started. But when you satisfy your soul in God first thing, when you drink deeply from his presence before you drink from anything else, there is a residual, a surplus, a reserve of joy that carries you even when things get hard. David said that we may rejoice and be glad all our days, all our days, not just Sundays, not just when things are going well, all our days, including the difficult days, including the confusing days, including the days when nothing seems to work and everything feels uphill. Because the joy is not rooted in the circumstances of the day. It is rooted in what was deposited in the morning encounter with God. And that is a deposit that the enemy cannot touch. Somebody shout satisfy me early Lord. All right. Let us begin to pray and I mean really pray. Not polite, quiet, mumbling under your breath prayer. Open your mouth. Let God hear your voice. Let the enemy hear your authority. And let heaven be moved by your faith. We are going into warfare this morning because every day is not just a calendar event. Every day is a spiritual territory that needs to be taken and you are taking it right now before it begins in the name of Jesus. Father, I bless your name. I bless your holy, excellent, matchless, incomparable name. You are the God who was there when the morning stars sang together and when the sons of God shouted for joy. Job 38:7. You are the ancient of days. You are the I am. You are the God who created time and who moves through time and who controls time. And I come before you this morning as a son and daughter of the kingdom covered in the blood of Jesus, filled with the Holy Spirit, standing on the covenant of grace. Lord, I receive this day as a gift from your hands. Psalm 118:24. This is the day which the Lord hath made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. I receive it. I take it from your hands and I consecrate it back to you before I leave a single hour of it. This day is yours and because it is yours, nothing that touches it today is outside of your awareness, outside of your sovereignty, outside of your governing grace. Now, Father, I come against everything that the enemy has arranged for this day. Every trap that was set last night while I slept, I expose it now by the light of the Holy Ghost. Every snare laid along the path of this day, I dismantle it now in the name of Jesus. Every accident that was scheduled by the enemy for today, I cancel it. Every sudden attack, every ambush, every surprise attack of the enemy canceled by the blood of Jesus. Every plan of darkness against my life for this day, void, null, powerless. Psalm 91:3, "He shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler." Deliver from every snare, every trap, every carefully constructed scheme of the enemy. Before it can close around my feet, God delivers me. I receive that deliverance now. I receive it now. Father, I cover myself with the blood of Jesus. I cover my mind. I cover every thought that will pass through my mind today. Let no unclean thought, no fearful thought, no faithless thought, no demonic suggestion take root in my mind today. Let the mind of Christ, Philippians 2:5, let the mind of Christ be the operating system of my mind for this day. I cover my mouth with the blood of Jesus. Let no word come out of my mouth today that does not build, that does not bless, that does not glorify God. Let the words of my mouth be seasoned with salt, Colossians 4:6. Let them be words of life, words of faith, words of prophetic potential. Let my mouth today be a weapon of righteousness and not a tool of destruction. I cover my eyes with the blood of Jesus. Let what I see today not contaminate my spirit. Let my eyes be anointed to see opportunity where others see obstacle. Let my eyes be open to the divine appointments that you have placed in this day. And let every seductive, polluting, corrupting image that the enemy tries to put in my path today be blood and be removed before it reaches me in the name of Jesus. I cover my ears with the blood of Jesus. Let me hear your voice today above every other voice. Let me be sensitive to the whisper of the Holy Spirit today. And let every lying voice, every discouraging voice, every voice of confusion and manipulation, let my ears be deaf to it. Let me hear what God is saying and be unmoved by what the enemy is suggesting. I cover my hands with the blood of Jesus. Let everything I put my hands to today prosper. [music] Deuteronomy 28:8, "The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in all that thou settest thine hand unto." Everything I put my hand to today blessed. Not some things, not the spiritual things, everything. The business calls, the documents, the projects, the meetings, the creative work, the physical labor. Everything my hands touch today becomes a site of divine blessing. I cover my feet with the blood of Jesus. Let my steps today be ordered by the Lord. Psalm 37:23, "The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord." Ordered, arranged, set in sequence by divine wisdom. I will not stumble today. I will not take the wrong turn today. I will not miss the divine appointment today. My feet are ordered by God. I go where he sends me and I arrive where he planned for me to be. Now, I want to pray about the specific territories you are entering today. For every person listening to this in a workplace environment, Lord, I release your favor into that workplace. Let there be a grace on this person today that makes them stand out. Not arrogantly, graciously. Let them carry the presence of God so strongly that people around them are affected without being able to explain why. Let the same anointing that was on Joseph in Potiphar's house, Genesis 39:3, "And his master saw that the Lord was with him." "And that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand." Let that anointing rest on them today. Let supervisors favor them. Let colleagues be drawn to them. Let opportunities align with them. And if there is anyone in that workplace who has been assigned by darkness to make their life difficult, to undermine them, to steal credit from them, to create hostility, Lord, neutralize that assignment. Disarm that opposition. And let even that enemy become a gateway to their promotion, the way Potiphar's house became a gateway for Joseph, even when it looked like the worst possible situation. I decree you will not be the tail in your workplace today. You will be the head. Deuteronomy 28:13, "You will not be overlooked. You will not be passed over. You will not be undervalued." Someone today will take notice of what God has put in you and will speak up on your behalf. Receive it. For every person who has a business to run today, Lord, send the customers. Send the connections. Send the contracts. Let this day bring a financial encounter that shifts the trajectory of the business. Let divine ideas come. Let strategies come that were not formed in a natural mind. Let the wisdom that Solomon had, 1 Kings 4:29, "And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much." Let that wisdom be available to every business person engaging with this morning prayer. Let every meeting today that is connected to a contract or a deal or an agreement, let the spirit of God be in that room. Let the right words come at the right time. Let the right numbers present themselves. And let the result be in favor of the kingdom and in favor of this business in the name of Jesus. For every student who is in this morning, Lord, let this be a day of supernatural academic performance. Let the things that were confusing become clear. Let memory be sharp. Let understanding be deep. Let concentration be sustained. Let the anointing that Daniel and his three friends carried, Daniel 1:17, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom. Let that same anointing rest on every student starting their day in this atmosphere. You will not fail. You will not perform below your potential. You will not be confused in any examination. You will not be overwhelmed by any assignment because the spirit of wisdom and understanding, Isaiah 11:2, is resting upon you. For every mother or father who is beginning a day of raising children, Lord, let there be grace for parenting today. Let there be patience that does not come from human reserves. Let there be wisdom to handle each child individually knowing how each one is designed. Let there be authority, godly, loving authority that commands respect without breaking spirit. Let your home today be a place of peace and purpose. And Lord, speak to those children through the events of this day. Let seeds that were planted in prayer and instruction begin to bear fruit. Let the wayward child take a step back today. Let the questioning child receive an answer today. Let the struggling child be helped today. And let the covenant over the household of believers be manifest. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. Joshua 24:15. Now, I want to go into a dimension of prayer that is specifically for the inner life because external breakthrough without internal alignment is not sustainable. Father, deal with my heart today. Psalm 51:10. Create in me a clean heart and renew a right spirit within me. Not just the actions, the heart. Not just the behavior, the motivation. Search me and know me as David prayed in Psalm 139:23. And whatever you find in me today that does not look like Jesus, correct it, confront it, uproot it. For the pride that sometimes makes me competitive instead of collaborative, Lord, give me the humility of Christ. For the fear that sometimes makes me hesitate when I should advance, Lord, give me the courage of David before Goliath. For the anxiety that sometimes steals my sleep and my peace, Lord, let your peace, which passes understanding, Philippians 4:7, garrison my heart and mind. For the unforgiving attitude that I sometimes carry into a new day, the offense I held onto from yesterday, the wound that I have not fully surrendered, Lord, today I release it. I release every person who wronged me. I release every disappointment. I release every unfulfilled expectation. I release it all into your hands. And I receive fresh mercy to extend to others the way you have extended it to me. Matthew 6:14. If you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. Father, let me be a better version of myself today than I was yesterday. Not by striving, [music] by yielding. Not by trying harder, by trusting deeper. Let the fruit of the Spirit love, joy, peace, long-suffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance. Galatians 5:22 and 23. Let every single one of these fruits be visible in how I engage with people today. Let the people I encounter today see something in me that they want. Not my talent, not my success. Jesus, let them see Jesus in how I speak, in how I listen, in how I respond to difficulty, in how I treat people who cannot do anything for me. Let me be a living epistle today. 2 Corinthians 3:2, read by every person I meet. I want to go into deep warfare now because there are specific battles that some of you are walking into today that need to be addressed with apostolic authority. There is someone listening to this today who is walking into a situation that terrifies you. A meeting that could change everything for good or for bad. A medical appointment you have been dreading. A confrontation you have been avoiding. A deadline that feels like a cliff edge. And you woke up this morning with that dread sitting on your chest like a physical weight. I speak to that dread right now. I command that spirit of fear to lift in the name of Jesus. 2 Timothy 1:7, "For God had not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." That is not your spirit. Fear is not native to you. You were not designed with fear as an operating principle. It was inserted. It was assigned. It was placed on you by a spirit whose purpose is to paralyze you before you even begin. And I break that assignment now. In the name of Jesus, spirit of fear, come off this person. Spirit of dread, lift. Spirit of foreboding, dissipate. And I release the spirit of power in its place. The spirit of love in its place. The spirit of a sound mind, a mind that thinks clearly, responds wisely, and refuses to be terrorized by the unknown. You will walk into that room today with your head up and your spirit steady. Not because the situation is not real. It may be very real, but because the God who is with you is more real than the situation. Isaiah 41:10, "Fear thou not, for I am with thee. Be not dismayed, for I am thy God. I will strengthen thee, yea, I will help thee, yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness." I will strengthen you. I will help you. I will uphold you. That is three promises in one verse, and all three are for today. Receive them. Now, for those dealing with financial pressure this morning, the bills that came in yesterday, the account balance that was not what it should be, the debt that is accumulating, the income that is insufficient, the financial hole that seems to be getting deeper rather than shallower, I need you to hear this today before you walk into any financial interaction. Philippians 4:19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." All your need, not most, not some, all. According to his riches in glory. Not according to your current account balance, not according to the state of the economy, not according to what your industry is doing right now, according to his riches. And his riches are inexhaustible. Father, I speak supernatural supply into the financial situation of everyone who brings this need before you this morning. Lord, open unexpected channels of provision. Let money come from sources that were not on the list. Let a phone call today bring financial relief. Let an idea come today that creates an income stream. Let a deal that was stalled begin to move. Let a payment that was overdue arrive. Let the financial pressure that has been mounting begin to release like a pressure valve that heaven opens. Let it release today. I decree you will not end this day in the same financial position you started it. Something is shifting. Something is moving. Heaven is repositioning resources in your direction even as we pray. You will not beg today. You will not be embarrassed today. You will have enough today. And not just enough, there will be extra. There will be overflow. Because our God is not a barely enough God. He is the God of Ephesians 3:20, able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think. For healing, for the person who woke up this morning in pain, in physical pain. Your body is speaking louder than you would like it to. There is something wrong and you feel it with every movement. And you carry that physical burden into a day that requires you to perform, to function, [music] to show up. Jesus is your healer today. He was wounded for your transgressions and bruised for your iniquities. And the chastisement of your peace was upon him. And with his stripes, Isaiah 53:5, you are healed. That is present tense. That is already accomplished. The healing is not coming. It came on Calvary. It was purchased. And today you are enforcing a purchase that was already made. Father, I speak healing into every aching body today. Into every inflamed joint. Into every malfunctioning organ. Into every disease process that is running in a body right now. Let the resurrection power of Jesus, the same power that raised him from the dead, Ephesians 1:20. Let that power be released into the body of every sick person engaged with this morning prayer. And for the person who is dealing with mental and emotional pain today, anxiety that is clinical, depression that is chemical, grief that is deep, trauma that is unresolved, Lord, let the healing of the spirit reach those places. Let the balm of Gilead, Jeremiah 8:22, be applied to the wounds of the soul. Let there be a peace today that did not come from a prescription, that did not come from a counseling session, a peace that surpasses understanding, that can only be explained by the presence of God. I decree healing. I decree wholeness. I decree health and vitality over everybody and every mind that was used to receive this morning word. Let me go into prophetic declarations now. Put your hand on your chest, over your heart, and receive these decrees into your spirit. I decree this day is my day of favor. Psalm 5:12 says, "For thou, Lord, will bless the righteous with favor will thou compass him as with a shield." Favor as a shield, surrounding me from every angle. I cannot be attacked through my lack of favor today because favor is a shield around me. I decree I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus, 2 Corinthians 5:21. And because I am righteous in him, I have right standing before God. My prayers are answered. My decrees are established. My presence in a room shifts the atmosphere. I decree no weapon formed against me today shall prosper, Isaiah 54:17. Every weapon, not some weapons, every weapon. The weapon of betrayal does not prosper. The weapon of false accusation does not prosper. The weapon of sudden loss does not prosper. The weapon of financial attack does not prosper. The weapon of sickness does not prosper. None of them prosper. I am covered. I am protected. I am held by the God who cannot fail. I decree my family is covered today. My spouse, my children, my parents, everyone connected to me by covenant of blood or marriage, the blood of Jesus covers them today. They do not go into today unprotected. They go wrapped in covenant covering. And every attack designed for my family is intercepted by angels before it arrives. I decree my destiny is intact. >> [music] >> The enemy has not ruined it. The mistakes of yesterday have not destroyed it. The delays and detours of the past have not canceled it. Romans 8:28, all things work together for good. All things, even the bad things, even the painful things. God is so sovereign that he takes what the enemy meant for harm and engineers it into a highway toward destiny. My destiny is intact. I decree I'm anointed for this day. Acts 10:38 says God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power. That same Holy Ghost that anointed Jesus is in me, is on me. Is with me today. And the anointing does not clock out at 9:00 a.m. when the alarm goes off. The anointing goes with me into the boardroom, into the classroom, into the kitchen, into the traffic. Into every conversation, into every challenge. The anointing is present all day. I decree angels are assigned to this day. Hebrews 1:14, are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? They are sent forth to minister, not to observe, not to spectate, to minister. [music] They are working on my behalf today in unseen places, in spaces I cannot access, in the hearts of people I will meet. >> [music] >> In the logistics of my day, angels are active in this day. And because I prayed this morning, because I opened this day in the spirit, they have clear instruction, they have clear assignment. They are moving. I receive angelic assistance for this day. Now, a final wave of prayer before I release you into your day. Father, let this day produce testimonies. Not just blessings silently received testimonies, stories to tell, evidence to display. Let something happen today that makes me reach for my phone not to scroll, but to share, to tell someone God showed up today, God moved in my situation today, God answered the prayer I prayed this morning before I started my day. Let there be a divine encounter today, a moment where heaven and earth touch in the middle of the ordinary, where suddenly in the middle of a routine moment, in the middle of a meeting, in the middle of a conversation, in the middle of a commute, God shows up and does something that could not have been arranged by human hands. For the person who will have a conversation today that will change the direction of their life, Lord, let them recognize it. Let them not miss the moment. Let them have ears to hear what the spirit is saying through that conversation, and let them respond with courage. For the person who will receive a phone call today that will carry good news they have been waiting for, let the joy of that call sustain their heart for months. Let it be the beginning of a new chapter, a new season, a new momentum. For the person who have an idea today, let it be a God idea, not just a creative idea, a God idea. An Isaiah 43:19 idea. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Something new. Something no one has done before. Something that when it is executed will leave people wondering where it came from. And you will know where it came from. It came from the morning, from this altar, from this encounter with God before the day started. Lord, at the end of this day, let every person who used this morning prayer as the beginning of their day come back to the altar tonight with gratitude. Let them have too many testimonies to even articulate. Let their gratitude overflow. Let their praise be loud. Let their thanksgiving be deep. And for some of them, Lord, let this be the day they made a habit. The day that morning prayer stopped being something they occasionally do and became something they cannot imagine a day without. Let it become as natural as breathing, as essential as food. Let them be ruined for starting a day any other way. Let them be so addicted to your presence in the morning that the thought of going into a day without it feels as strange and as dangerous as going into battle without armor because it I S dangerous and they now know it and they choose differently. I speak supernatural acceleration into this day. What would normally take weeks, compress it into days. What would normally take months, let it happen in this week. God is a God of acceleration. He is not limited by the pace of natural processes. He can do in a moment what natural progression would take years to accomplish. I decree acceleration. I decree speed. I decree divine compression of timeline over every area of your life that has been moving too slowly. I decree open heavens over this day. No spiritual hindrance. No demonic barrier. No atmospheric resistance. The heavens are open and the blessing of God is flowing freely. Malachi 3:10, "I will open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. Not room enough to receive it." You are going to need bigger containers for what God releases today. I decree supernatural wisdom for this day. James 1:5, "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God that giveth to all men liberally and upbraideth not, and it shall be given him." A S K, and it shall be given. Not might be, shall be. Given liberally, generously, without measure, without stinginess. God is not parceling out wisdom in tiny doses. He gives it liberally. I ask for wisdom for everyone engaged with this morning prayer. Wisdom in relationships, wisdom in business, wisdom in parenting, wisdom in ministry, wisdom in financial decisions, wisdom in navigating complex situations. >> [music] >> Let the spirit of wisdom rest on them. Today, as Isaiah 11:2 promises, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the [music] spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord. Sevenfold spirit, all seven dimensions active today in your home, in your workplace, in your car, in your meetings, in your conversations. The spirit of the Lord resting on you today and operating in every dimension. Now, I want to send you into your day with this final word. You are not going into this day alone. The God of the universe, the God who created every star in every galaxy, who laid the foundations of the earth, who knew you before you were formed in the womb, who counted every hair on your head, that God is going with you into this day. He is going before you. He is going behind you. He is going beside you. He is inside you. You are so comprehensively covered by the presence of God that there is not a single inch of your life that his watchful eye is not fixed upon. Deuteronomy 31:8, "And the Lord he it is that doth go before thee, he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee, fear not, neither be dismayed." He goes before. He's not reacting to your day. He's already in your day. He's already in the meeting you have not yet arrived at. He's already in the conversation that has not yet started. He's already in the situation that has not yet unfolded. He's already there and he's arranging things and he's preparing the way. And what will feel like a coincidence to you today is his sovereign fingerprint on the details of your life. So, go. Go with confidence. Go with peace. Go with joy. Go with the boldness of a lion. Proverbs 28:1, "The righteous are bold as a lion." You are righteous. Be bold. Walk into this day like someone who has prayed because you have. Walk into this day like someone who has been with God this morning because you have. And let your life today be a sermon. Let your peace be a message. Let your joy be a testimony. Let your competence be a witness. Let your kindness be an act of ministry. Let everything about you today declare I serve a living God. I was in his presence this morning and it shows. Go in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost. And come back tomorrow morning and do it again and the morning after that and the morning after that until it is as natural as sunrise itself. Until this is where your day begins every single day without exception. Because this this altar, this morning encounter, this deliberate choosing of God before anything else, this is where champions are made. This is where the difference between a life that looks spiritual and a life that is spiritual gets determined. Not on Sundays, not in the big meetings. In the quiet, daily, consistent, faithful, sometimes inconvenient morning encounter with the living God. Do it. Every morning before you start your day, go in peace, in power, in the fullness of the spirit, in Jesus' name. Amen.
